event_description: A learner opened the full course catalog.
A learner opened a course detail page.
A learner submitted a search query from the hero or compact search field.
The search agent returned ranked results to the browser.
A search did not return results because of a rate limit, an agent error or a network failure.
A learner changed the sort order on the search results page.
A learner opened a search result, carrying whether it was a video moment or a lesson.
A learner pressed play on a lesson video.
Estimated watch depth crossed a 25, 50, 75 or 95 percent milestone.
Estimated watch depth reached 95 percent of a lesson video.
A learner arrived at a lesson positioned at a specific second, resuming rather than starting over.
A learner pressed Start or Continue Learning on a course.
Server-side record of one search agent run, with its outcome, model, step count and latency.
Server-side: a search was refused by the per-IP rate limiter.
